route_contract.name: intent_router
route_contract.rule: This is the only decision made by API 1.

changes_contract.description: Structured requested mutations or desired values. Empty for read-only inspect/navigation operations.

compound_contract.description: One or more structured operations for compound requests. A simple action may contain exactly one operation.

rules: API 1 returns exactly chat or action and no other data.
chat goes to the natural reply API and then stops without mutation.
action goes to API 2, which returns exactly one action family: build, update, inspect, publish, delete, or navigate.
API 3 receives the locked action family and resolves domain, operation, scope, structured target, changes, constraints, and compound operations.
API 3 must choose a finite leaf_operation registered for the selected domain; arbitrary operation names are rejected or normalized.
API 3 is forbidden from changing the API 2 action family.
Routing depth for normal action turns is at most three classifier APIs before deterministic/planner execution.
Every action is represented by action, domain, operation, scope, structured target, changes, constraints, and operations.
Compound user requests are decomposed into operations[] rather than flattened into vague prose.
build routes through design/composition, locked content generation, apply, and verification.
update routes through target/change planning, apply, and verification.
inspect is read-only and must never mutate website state.
publish and navigation use dedicated executors rather than the design planner.
All intermediate AI outputs are JSON only.
Normal build, update, inspect, publish, and navigate actions never require a proceed layer.
Only destructive delete may retain explicit safety confirmation.
A natural final reply is generated only after execution verification or verified read-only inspection.

domain_router_contract.name: domain_operation_router
domain_router_contract.rule: API 3 may resolve domain, operation, scope, target, changes and compound operations but may not change the locked API 2 action family.

leaf_action_contract.rule: leaf_operation must be one of the finite operations registered for the selected domain. operation remains the backwards-compatible executor operation.
leaf_action_contract.validation: required_changes declared by the selected leaf schema must be present before execution.

reference_spark_contract.rule: reference_spark Batch 3 accepts a screenshot/image attachment and, for single_spark, returns deterministic current-page placement choices before Sol vision -> validated AI Flex. The user chooses an anchor Spark and then insert above, insert below, or replace. whole_page segmentation remains Batch 4.

action_source_contract.name: action_source_router
action_source_contract.rule: API 2 decides whether an ACTION is standard CMS work or depends on a visual reference. It does not choose CMS scope, Spark target, placement, or mutation schema.
